import sys, json, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
Path('/app/output/spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
obs = r.get_obs(depth=True)
seq = 0

def save(res, tag):
    global obs
    obs = res
    res.save('/app/output/' + tag)
    for cam, img in res.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(img).save('/app/output/' + tag + '_' + cam + '.png')
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k,v in res.meta.items() if k not in ['cameras','proprio']}, default=str))
    print('TCP', res.group('tcp_pose', now=True))

save(obs, 'initial')
print('SPEC', json.dumps(spec))
PY

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /app/output/step.py <<'PY'
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation, Slerp

def joints():
    a=obs.group('joint_pos',now=True)
    return np.r_[a[:7],a[8:15]]

def move(arm, pose, opening=None, duration=3, tag='move'):
    global obs
    start=obs.group('joint_pos',now=True)
    sol=r.ik({'Gripper_Tip_'+arm:pose},seed=joints())
    print('IK',sol)
    if not sol['ok']: return False
    end=start.copy(); inds=slice(0,7) if arm=='R' else slice(8,15)
    q=np.array(sol['q']); end[inds]=q[:7] if arm=='R' else q[7:]
    if opening is not None: end[7 if arm=='R' else 15]=opening
    n=int(duration/.1)
    A=np.linspace(start,end,n)
    res=r.submit('joint_position',A,dt=.1,video='none',depth=True,note=tag)
    save(res,tag)
    return True
qdown=[0,2**-.5,2**-.5,0]
move('L',[.48,.10,1.07]+qdown,.05,4,'overhead')
PY"}));

steps.text: The container is securely lifted. I’m checking a reachable tipping motion above the green area so the cube can slide out with a short drop.
The container pivots between the fingertips when held near the rim. I’ll set it down and grasp lower on its body to get better control of the tilt.
The container slipped during the turn and is now lying on its side; the cube appears to remain inside. I’ll lift the closed end so the opening points downward and lets the cube fall out.
The cube is out and resting just beyond the green area. I’ll set the container aside, then pick up the cube and place it near the target’s center.
